infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This identifier will be used to deliver personalized content to you.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Cunningham Fitness sends timer and workout notifications so you can stay on track.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Cunningham Fitness uses your location to track your run route and distance on the map.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Cunningham Fitness uses the local network to sync athlete metrics with the trainer desktop app when you start Trainer Sync.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Cunningham Fitness uses motion data to count your steps and improve run tracking.
infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Cunningham Fitness reads your health data (steps, heart rate, sleep, workouts) to give you a complete fitness overview.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Cunningham Fitness saves your workouts and runs to Apple Health so all your data stays in sync.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Cunningham Fitness uses your camera to check exercise posture and update your profile photo.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Cunningham Fitness to use your camera to check exercise posture.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow Cunningham Fitness to access your photos for your profile picture.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Cunningham Fitness to use your camera to take a profile picture.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Cunningham Fitness to use your location to track your run route and distance.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Cunningham Fitness to use your location to track your run route and distance.
